results.title: Nollywood icon Pete Edochie is dead
results.description: Nigeria’s entertainment industry has lost one of its greatest icons, Chief Pete Edochie, the legendary Nollywood actor and veteran broadcaster who dominated television and cinema screens for decades. Edochie died in the early hours of Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at the age of 79, following a prolonged battle with prostate cancer. His death was announced […]

results.title: A voice that defined an era! Adnan Siddiqui mourns Bunny’s death
results.description: Pakistani actor Adnan Siddiqui has paid an emotional tribute to legendary pop singer Mohsin Raza Khan, popularly known as Bunny, following his death at the age of 74.
